title: Swan Song
start: Speak to Herman Caranos at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony.

items.t: Empty pot and pot lid (there's a potter's wheel in Draynor if you need it, or the Barbarian Village has everything required to make your own)
7 bones (can be obtained during the quest)
5 iron bars (can be obtained during the quest, requiring smelting from iron ores)

recommended.t: Activated Eagles' Peak (or memory strand teleport), Draynor, Port Sarim and Yanille lodestones
Cooking gauntlets or Cooking cape (Less chance to burn monkfish)
Prayer restoration such as prayer potions

kills.t: 10 sea trolls (one each of levels 56/77/84 and seven of level 63)

rewards.t: Access to the Piscatoris Fishing Colony
Able to use Skeletal mages for training
Bank and obelisk very close by
Can get the following items from Malignius Mortifer upon request:
Bone seeds (requires pot and pot lid)
Able to transmute raw bass into raw monkfish

steps.t: Talk to Herman Caranos outside the Piscatoris Fishing Colony (fairy ring code AKQ or memory strand teleport, then run northeast). [Chat: 1 What's the rush? › 1 Do you need any help? › Accept]
p: The Drunken Dwarf, getting killed by the Wise Old Man.

steps.t: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor. [Chat: 1 Would you like to go on a quest?]
Head back to the Piscatoris Colony. Talk to the Wise Old Man. [Chat: 1 I'm ready to fight.]
Kill the sea trolls and open the colony gate.
Talk to Herman in the eastern building.
Talk to Franklin Caranos near the entrance.
In the building directly north of Franklin, use a log on the firebox (the east side of the large metal contraption in the middle of the room), then light the firebox by clicking on it.

sub.t: Logs and iron ores can be obtained just outside of the colony. The firebox is the metal box on the east side of the metal press.

steps.t: Use 5 iron bars on the Metal Press to get 5 iron sheets.
Use the iron sheets on the broken colony walls to the west.
Talk to Franklin.
Right-click on Arnold Lydspor in the bank to talk to him.
Catch at least five fresh monkfish to the northwest. You'll be attacked by sea trolls when fishing. This can take up to 10 minutes depending on your Fishing level.
p: The Wise Old Man fighting the sea trolls.

steps.t: Cook the monkfish in the kitchen southwest. You will need to turn in five fresh monkfish; if any are burned, fish for more. To cook them, just use them on the range and don't proceed on Make-X interface.
p: Fixing the walls with the sheets of iron.
Sea trolls may randomly attack a player while fishing for fresh monkfish.

steps.t: Talk to Arnold.
Talk to the Wise Old Man and Herman (furthest building to the east). [Chat: 2 Something else.]
Talk to Wizard Frumscone in the basement of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. [Chat: 2 I'll see what the necromancer needs me to do.]

sub.t: Fetch the required supplies now, if you haven't already.

steps.t: Talk to Malignius Mortifer northwest of Port Sarim near the crossroads. [Chat: 2 I need help with saving a fishing colony.]
Talk to any Almost Master Crafter inside the Crafting Guild until one talks to you about crafting pot lids.
Talk to Malignius Mortifer, he will teleport you to the colony, so gear up before speaking with him. [Chat: 2 I've spoken to the master crafter...]
Talk to Herman. [Chat: 1 I'm ready. Let's fight!]
Kill the Sea Troll Queen.

sub.t: Banks recover health rapidly, and while the bank isn't functional until quest completion, you can run into the building and next to the banker to recover health.

p: The Sea Trolls rise from the ocean depths.
The Wise Old Man kills the Sea Troll General
The Wise Old Man is badly hurt by a powerful water spell.

steps.t: Talk to Herman.
Quest complete!
